title: ATS error, v1 (draft)
description: Body of every non-2xx response from the ATS service, except the plain-text 400 that refuses a CORS preflight (an OPTIONS request that the CORS settings do not allow); browsers never show that reply to page code. Clients branch on `code` and may show `message` to the user; neither contains internal details. Clients ignore properties they do not know. Draft: expect changes until both owners mark it stable.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Current codes: invalid-request (400, 422), not-found (404), method-not-allowed (405), file-too-large (413), not-a-pdf (415), pdf-encrypted (422), pdf-unreadable (422), analysis-timeout (422), rate-limited (429, with a Retry-After header in seconds), internal-error (500), server-busy (503, with a Retry-After header in seconds), and http-error for any other status. New codes may be added within v1.

message.description: Plain-English explanation that can be shown to the user.
